title: Hooks, bodies and calls to action that the references use

entries.when: tutorial or tool list for a technical audience
entries.do: Open with a prohibition plus the number of items: 'Don't use X unless you've installed these five'. The first noun appears on screen as a title card at the same moment.

evidence.note: Don't use Claude code unless you've installed these five plugins

entries.when: story or demo; a surprising stake in one sentence
entries.do: Say the rule-breaking claim as a fact with a concrete number: 'make 100 versions fight to the death', 'buried a man alive with a bell tied to his finger'; do not explain until the next sentence.

evidence.note: make 100 versions of Claude fight to the death
They buried a man alive with a bell tied to his finger
He bent the roller coaster's loop out of shape... it cost him everything

entries.when: a tool or repo is the subject
entries.do: Authority + number: 'Someone open sourced... passed 11,000 stars'; 'Twenty-five repos... you only need four'.

evidence.note: Someone open sourced a Claude coach... passed 11,000 stars
25 GitHub repos... you only need four of them

entries.when: story shorts in a made-up place
entries.do: State the rule of the world in one sentence with a number ('everyone is only allowed 1 million steps'); the next sentence shows the consequence; a glowing number on a character proves it.

evidence.note: In this town, everyone is only allowed to take 1 million steps
a haystack, 5 million straws, and one golden needle
If you plant a tree beside an empty road, cars will steer right into it

entries.when: a joke or conflict between two characters
entries.do: Start mid-argument with the user's complaint: 'Claude, I asked you to fix one typo!'; the reply answers in character; no setup line.

evidence.note: Claude, I asked you to fix one typo!
Claude, I graduated today. Zero offers.
Why does AI get dumber the longer I chat?

entries.do: Name the trend, the gap and the promise: 'Everyone is doing X, but nobody is showing you how. So I'll show you everything.'

evidence.note: Everyone's making AI animated reels... nobody's showing you how
same template for Instagram automation
This one folder makes every kind of reel

entries.do: Each item: name, the problem in one clause, the fix in one clause, one proof (number or screenshot): 'The problem: the limit runs out mid-work. Omni-Rout connects 200 providers.' 4-5 items in 45-55 s; the last item is the strongest.

evidence.note: The problem... / the fix...
five plugins listed first/second/third

entries.do: Setup (who wants what) -> escalation (a rival, a rule, a crowd) -> reversal (the physics or logic trick) -> payoff image; one open loop closes every 15 s; each line either opens, closes, shows, turns or lands.

evidence.note: rival copies the loop, the trick makes the copy fail
tree sign, crashes, target fixation explained, the sign becomes a stump
the needle was in the video the whole time

entries.when: any tutorial, promo or tool short
entries.do: 'Comment KEYWORD and I'll send you the link/setup/kit': one short keyword that is a real word from the video, said once, shown in a comment-box overlay, repeated in the caption; 4-6 s at the end.

evidence.note: comment Claude
comment ARENA
comment pre-sell
comment reels
comment Wi-Fi
comment kit

entries.do: End on an unresolved choice or question to the viewer ('So would you open it?') followed by an end card 'PART N / FOLLOW FOR PART N+1'.

evidence.note: ...So would you open it? then PART 3 / FOLLOW FOR PART 4
What power would you pick? then PART 2

entries.do: Close with a callback or a reframe that recontextualises the first line ('It was in this video the whole time' / 'the whole town walks upside down'); a plug is one sentence at most.

evidence.note: Did you see it before I did?
the whole town walks upside down
connect viral explainers to Claude, link in bio

entries.do: A last line that is a joke at the AI's or the user's expense and also states the tool: 'Your billing code hasn't run since March.'; then the keyword CTA.

evidence.note: I don't delete it. So? I'm mentioning it. Your billing code hasn't run since March.
My chat called Help is from March. I know. I'm still reading it.
